title.en: Your engine's most important ratio is 2 to 1 #shorts

description.en: Why the camshaft turns at half crank speed: the 2:1 timing gear ratio of a four-stroke engine.
description.id: Kenapa noken as berputar setengah kecepatan poros engkol: rasio gigi timing 2:1 pada mesin empat tak.

scenes.en: Your engine's most important gear ratio is exactly *2 to 1*.
scenes.id: Rasio gigi terpenting di mesinmu persis *2 banding 1*.

scenes.en: The crankshaft turns *twice* for one full four-stroke cycle.
scenes.id: Poros engkol berputar *dua kali* untuk satu siklus empat tak penuh.

scenes.en: But each valve only needs to open *once* in that cycle.
scenes.id: Tapi tiap katup cuma perlu terbuka *sekali* dalam siklus itu.

scenes.en: So the camshaft turns at *half* the crank's speed.
scenes.id: Jadi noken as berputar dengan *setengah* kecepatan poros engkol.

scenes.en: That's why the cam gear has *twice as many teeth* as the crank gear.
scenes.id: Makanya gigi noken as punya *dua kali lipat jumlah gigi* dibanding gigi poros engkol.

scenes.en: A chain or belt keeps them locked. If it *skips a tooth*, valves open at the wrong time.
scenes.id: Rantai atau sabuk menjaganya tetap terkunci. Kalau *meloncat satu gigi*, katup terbuka di waktu yang salah.

scenes.en: Two to one: the heartbeat of the timing. Follow for more.
scenes.id: Dua banding satu: detak jantung sistem timing. Follow untuk video lainnya.
